notes.title: New Serve: Leslie's Grand Slam Ending Unveiled!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906696/7816fb53cc4bef326421b98a5a52472573f15235.png[/img]
[h1]Exciting News! [/h1]

[h3]We've heard your requests loud and clear! By popular demand, we're thrilled to announce that we've added a new ending for Leslie, the American Tennis Player, in our game. Now you can enjoy even more depth to her story and see where your choices lead. Thank you for all your support and feedback. Dive back into the game and experience Leslie's new ending today![/h3]
